newsitem.title: USA: Snyder files to offer 7.7 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Snyder files to offer 7.7 million shares.

text.p: Snyder Communications Inc filed on Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 7,721,895 common shares.
It said in the filing that 1.5 million shares are being offered by the company, and 6,221,895 are being sold by stockholders.

It said 6,177,56 shares are being offered for sale initially in the United States and Canada by U.S. underwriters, and 1,544,379 shares are being offered for sale outside the U.S. and Canada by international underwriters.

The selling stockholders have granted the U.S. underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option on up to 926,627 additional shares and granted international underwriters an option on up to 231,657 additional shares.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Goldman Sachs & Co, Montgomery Securities, and Bear, Stearns & Co Inc.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 48.5 million.
Net proceeds will be used to fund potential acquisitions and for working capital, capital expenditures and general corporate purposes, Snyder said in the filing.
Sndyer, based in Bethesda, Md., is a provider of solutions primarily to Fortune 500 companies that outsource elements of their global sales and marketing efforts.
